name: definition-majority-tie-transition
description: Invalid definition (fiscalclock 0.2.0). 1 December years change to 1 February years through a two-month transition, 2024-12-01 to 2025-01-31, with 31 days in 2024 and 31 in 2025, so no calendar year holds more than half. Every 1 December year and every 1 February year has a majority, so details.years lists only the calendar year in which the transition starts, 2024. The complete error list is asserted (code, path and details).

source.citation: spec/definition-v1.md, Year numbers must be unique (fiscalclock 0.2.0); path from spec/api-v1.md, Paths for common errors
